newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: 10 FIRMS SO FAR BID TO ADVISE ON TELECOM SALE.
newsitem.headline: 10 FIRMS SO FAR BID TO ADVISE ON TELECOM SALE.

text.p: The European Affairs ministry said on Wednesday more than 10 foreign companies expressed an interest in drawing up a privatisation plan for state-run Lithuanian Telecom.

"More than 10 foreign companies expressed their interst to take part in the tender to become the lead advisor to the government on the Lithuanian Telecom privatisation," said Vytenis Junevichius, the ministry's director of privatisation.
Junevichius refused to say which companies submitted their applications as the dealine is May 9.
"European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene is expected to call a news conference on May 10 and she will provide further details," Junevichius said.
He also said the advisor is expected to be chosen before the end of June.
The government has said that the actual privatisation of company, which has share capital of 757.3 million litas, may begin at the start of next year.
